definitions.explanation: Lacking courage, easily frightened, or hesitant to take risks.

examples.japanese: {臆病|おくびょう}な{性格|せいかく}を{直|なお}したい。
examples.english: I want to fix my timid personality.

examples.japanese: この{犬|いぬ}は{臆病|おくびょう}で、{大|おお}きな{音|おと}を{怖|こわ}がる。
examples.english: This dog is timid and is afraid of loud sounds.

examples.japanese: {臆病|おくびょう}{風|かぜ}に{吹|ふ}かれて、{挑戦|ちょうせん}をやめてしまった。
examples.english: I got cold feet and gave up on the challenge.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{臆|おく} (hesitate) + {病|びょう} (illness, condition) - literally "condition of hesitation"

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{臆病|おくびょう}{者|もの} - coward
・{臆病|おくびょう}{風|かぜ}に{吹|ふ}かれる - to get cold feet (lit. blown by the wind of cowardice)
・{臆病|おくびょう}な{心|こころ} - timid heart

USAGE:
Generally used negatively, though sometimes sympathetically.

ANTONYM:
・{大胆|だいたん} - bold, daring
・{勇敢|ゆうかん} - brave, courageous

RELATED:
・{弱虫|よわむし} - weakling, coward (informal)
・{怖|こわ}がり - scaredy-cat
